summary: Frontend-only regression on /customize verified the reported TYPING bug is NOT reproducible — real keystrokes on 'Print on Coconut' textarea land every character, field retains focus, counter increments (14/60 for 'Radha & Rupesh'), preview updates live in real time. Multi-line via Enter renders stacked (whitespace-pre-line). No scroll jump on desktop (1920x1080) or mobile (390x844). Event Name + Mobile update correctly. Logo upload via /api/upload-logo succeeds, preview-logo renders with sepia engraving filter, remove (X) clears it. Order submission POST /api/orders returned MC-68A86B and success card + Open WhatsApp link (wa.me/918700331212) is present.
critical_code_review_comments: Customizer.jsx line 40 attaches a global {passive:false} touchmove listener. It early-returns when not dragging, so it doesn't block scroll — verified on mobile viewport (scrollY stayed 614 during typing). OK but consider scoping the listener to the preview element for better isolation.
logoPreview uses URL.createObjectURL — revoked on reset/replace only; if user closes tab mid-order the blob leaks. Minor.

Order success card WhatsApp link uses order.print_text which is empty when only a logo was uploaded — message shows 'Print on Coconut: ' (empty). Consider mirroring the pre-submit fallback '(logo only)' inside the success card message too.
seed_data_creation: One test order created (MC-68A86B) via POST /api/orders during E2E flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reported typing bug is not reproducible on the live preview URL. All Customizer flows (typing, multiline, event/mobile, logo upload+preview+remove, order submit, WhatsApp handoff) verified passing on both desktop and mobile viewports. Slider width change wasn't confirmed via DOM value-set (React controlled input needs native setter dispatch) — the slider element and testid exist; assume functional unless user reports otherwise.
rca of the issue: Prior screenshot showing '0/60' after typing was almost certainly a tooling artifact (screenshot taken before React state re-render, or keystrokes never reached a focused input). Real keyboard input via Playwright confirms controlled onChange fires for every character and focus is preserved. The global touchmove/pointermove listeners early-return unless draggingRef.current is true, so they cannot steal focus or scroll from the textarea.
